turn_prompts: Read the host-projected candidate snapshot and validation receipt. Do not write files; submit only typed findings.

For a repairable issue use code test_quality_defect, producing_stage test_quality_critic, and target_writer authoring_repair. Set candidate_digest exactly to candidate_validation_identity.candidate_snapshot_digest, and set both evidence_digest and diagnostic_digest exactly to candidate_validation_identity.validation_receipt_digest. These are the semantic identities inside the typed artifacts: never use artifacts[].digest, which only hashes an outer JSON container. If the validation receipt is rejected, emit test_quality_defect from its bounded diagnostics; do not return an empty finding.

The finding content must be exactly one JSON object with these eight keys and no other keys: format, version, code, producing_stage, evidence_digest, target_writer, candidate_digest, diagnostic_digest. Use format workflowkit.workflow-finding.v1 and version 1. Do not include summary, evidence, diagnostics, repair_guidance, required_repair, or prose fields. Completion requires exactly one harbor_submit_output tool call, never a prose final answer. Submit every declared output with {"verdict":"pass","artifacts":[{"name":"DECLARED_OUTPUT_NAME","content":"STRUCTURED_ARTIFACT"}]}; use the exact declared name and one entry for each declared output.
